title: OMRON D2F Ultra Subminiature Basic Switch, data sheet, 6 pages
_label: added 2026-11-15. Read since 2026-11-15 by mechloop/parts/details.py ENDSTOP (hinge_lever_models: operating position 6.8 +/-1.5 mm, overtravel, movement differential, operating force, free position) and hence endstop_switch() and the subsystems verifier's endstop check

variants_covered.ref: p.1 model number legend, p.2 list of models

ratings.D2F: 125 VAC 3 A (1 A for the low-force type), 30 VDC 2 A (0.5 A)

hinge_lever_pcb_models: and the -T, -A, -A1 terminal forms of the first four

body_and_mounting.ref: p.3 'Terminals/Appearances' and 'Mounting Holes', p.4 drawings; general tolerance +/-0.4 unless stated

mounting_holes.second_hole_as_drawn: 2.2 +0.12/0 dia. on the pin plunger drawing
mounting_holes.screw: M2 with plain or spring washer, 0.08 to 0.1 N.m (p.5)

hinge_lever_models.ref: p.4 'Hinge Lever Models' drawing and table. OP and FP are dimensioned from the centre line of the two mounting holes to the lever at point A; operation is in direction A (towards the body)

lever.point_A_note: reference dimension in brackets; 4.3 mm beyond the second hole, 7.55 mm from the body centre

hinge_lever_models.pretravel: not specified for lever models (only for the pin plunger: 0.5 mm max)

ratings_and_characteristics.bounce: contact open or close 1 ms max under those

compared_with_endstop_switch.catalogue_frame: mounting-hole line of the switch at Y = 1.6 (details.ENDSTOP hole_line_y); lever pressed towards -Y
compared_with_endstop_switch.body: 12.8 x 6.55 x 5.8 in the catalogue; sheet 12.8 x 6.5 x 5.8: agrees
compared_with_endstop_switch.trigger: catalogue 9.0 mm above the hole line (Y = 10.6), taken from a recalled 'operating position 10 +/-1'. Sheet: OP 6.8 +/-1.5 mm (5.3 to 8.3). The recalled figure is the FREE position (10 mm max), not the operating position. The catalogue trigger is 2.2 mm above the nominal OP and 0.7 mm above the highest OP any switch may have
compared_with_endstop_switch.lever_free: catalogue 9.99 mm above the hole line; sheet FP 10 mm max: agrees with the maximum
compared_with_endstop_switch.pretravel: catalogue 0.99 mm; sheet gives none for lever models; FP max minus OP is 3.2 mm at nominal (1.7 to 4.7)
compared_with_endstop_switch.overtravel: catalogue 3.95 mm (to the lever lying on the case); sheet guarantees 0.55 mm minimum after the operating position
compared_with_endstop_switch.movement_differential: not in the catalogue; sheet 0.5 mm max (release point above the operating point)
compared_with_endstop_switch.trigger_x: catalogue lever tip 9.0 mm from the body centre (community model); sheet's point A is 7.55 mm from the body centre
compared_with_endstop_switch.pin_holes: X = -5.08, 0, 5.08 agree. For an Omron right- or left-angled switch lying on a board the legs are 2.6 +/-0.2 mm below the body bottom (catalogue row: 0.9 mm below) and reach 3.1 mm from the body face, i.e. 1.5 mm through a 1.6 mm board (catalogue: 2.62 mm)
compared_with_endstop_switch.mount_holes_m3: the two M3 holes at +/-7.5 belong to the generated carrier board, not to the switch; the switch's own holes are 2 x 2.0 dia on 6.5 mm
